newsitem.title: UK: Rexam shares gain after newspaper tip.
newsitem.headline: Rexam shares gain after newspaper tip.

text.p: Shares in Britain's packaging and printing group Rexam plc gained 10p to 272-1/2 on Monday, boosted by bullish comments in the Sunday Telegraph, dealers said.
The newspaper said that while conditions in Rexam's markets remain highly competitive, Rexam shares may have bottomed out after having fallen from a 408-1/2p high in September.
The Sunday Telegraph believes the shares are set for a recovery after Rexam restructured its business and cut staff by 1,200.
Rexam said last month that trading in the first three months of the year had started "promisingly".
